import click
from click.testing import CliRunner
def test_range():
    kind = click.IntRange(1, 3)
    assert kind.convert('1', None, None) == 1
    assert kind.convert('3', None, None) == 3
def test_command():
    @click.command()
    def hello():
        click.echo('hello')
    result = CliRunner().invoke(hello)
    assert result.exit_code == 0
    assert result.output == 'hello\n'

import markupsafe
def test_python_backend():
    assert markupsafe._escape_inner.__module__ == 'markupsafe._native'
    assert str(markupsafe.escape('<a>')) == '<a>'
def test_none_semantics():
    assert str(markupsafe.escape(None)) == 'None'
    assert str(markupsafe.escape_silent(None)) == ''
